versions.changelog:
No user-visible changes in this version.

- Updated documentation to clarify that concept/resource/overview pages cannot substitute for single-file entity pages (minor wording fix in "硬性规则" section).
- No code or logic changes.

No user-facing changes in this version.

- Version bump to 1.0.3 with no detected file changes.

local-document-ingest 1.0.2

- Clarified that empty local folder scans (无内容变化) now skip skill execution; only content changes create tasks.
- Strengthened emphasis on prior “knowledge graph planning” before page generation—pages should naturally fit existing knowledge structure, not just be mass-produced.
- Refined rules and documentation for updating/creating overview, concept, and resource pages: only create such pages when they clearly aid navigation, synthesis, or reuse.
- Updated examples and JSON schema to add support for `relatedPages`, giving more explicit structure for linking overview and related wiki pages.
- Provided additional technical notes clarifying `itemKey` semantics (esp. regarding path/content change) and input expectations. 
- Improved guidance for cross-file link maintenance, mandating meaningful wikilinks in Markdown content (not just metadata).

- Initial release of v1.0.1 with Python bytecode cache files added to the scripts/ directory.
- No functional or source code changes; this update only includes the addition of compiled .pyc files for faster script execution.

local-document-ingest 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Enables ingestion of locally uploaded files into the Research Knowledge Base, focusing on desktop-uploaded folders.
- Processes only files explicitly listed in each upload payload, generating a dedicated type-specific wiki entity page for every readable file.
- Archives original files under standardized source_files/local_folder/ directories, without exposing absolute local file paths.
- Updates associated pages, synthesizes concept/resource/overview pages as needed, and maintains relevant catalog and index metadata.
- Strict validation of file hashes, source trace, and metadata; provides skipped source reporting for unreadable or mismatched files.
- Returns unified backend task result JSON; script workflow ensures deterministic, rule-based automation and integration.
